record.paper_title: Open problems in dynamics and related fields
record.original_question: Let A′ be the ring of adeles formed by taking the product over a subset of places of Q, and let Γ be an irreducible lattice in SL(2,A′). What are the finite ergodic D(A′)-invariant measures on SL(2,A′)/Γ, where D is the diagonal subgroup in SL(2)?

evidence.quote: QUESTION 9 (E. Lindenstrauss) . Let A′ be deﬁned as the ring of adeles, but the product is taken over a subset of places of Q and Γ an “irreducible” lattice in SL(2, A′). What are the ﬁnite ergodic D (A′)-invariant measures on SL(2, A′)/Γ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S$ be a (possibly infinite) subset of the set of places of $\mathbb{Q}$, and let $\mathbb{A}'=\prod'_{v\in S}\mathbb{Q}_v$ denote the corresponding restricted direct product (the "partial" ring of adeles, restricted with respect to the rings $\mathbb{Z}_p$ at the finite places $p\in S$). Consider the locally compact group $G=\mathrm{SL}(2,\mathbb{A}')=\prod'_{v\in S}\mathrm{SL}(2,\mathbb{Q}_v)$, and let $D\subset \mathrm{SL}(2)$ denote the diagonal subgroup, so that $D(\mathbb{A}')=\prod'_{v\in S}D(\mathbb{Q}_v)$ acts on $G$ by left or right multiplication.

Let $\Gamma\subset G$ be an irreducible lattice (i.e. a discrete subgroup of finite covolume whose projection to any proper sub-product of factors is dense). Consider the homogeneous space $G/\Gamma$ with its $D(\mathbb{A}')$-action.

Classify all finite (Borel, regular) ergodic $D(\mathbb{A}')$-invariant probability measures on $G/\Gamma$.
artifact.category_tag: Adelic homogeneous dynamics and measure rigidity
artifact.status_search_result: No complete classification of finite ergodic $D(\mathbb{A}')$-invariant measures on $\mathrm{SL}(2,\mathbb{A}')/\Gamma$ for irreducible lattices appears in the literature. Lindenstrauss and collaborators have classified positive-entropy measures and obtained adelic measure rigidity results in arithmetic settings (e.g., the work on arithmetic quantum unique ergodicity), but the general classification without entropy hypotheses for the full diagonal action over a partial adelic product remains, to the best of available evidence, open.

status_evidence.title: Invariant measures and arithmetic quantum unique ergodicity (E. Lindenstrauss, Annals of Math. 2006)
status_evidence.snippet: Classifies measures on Γ\SL(2,ℝ)×L invariant and of positive entropy under the diagonal subgroup and recurrent under L; uses arithmetic/Hecke structure rather than treating the general adelic diagonal-invariant case.
status_evidence.claim: Existing measure-classification results require positive-entropy or recurrence hypotheses; the unconditional adelic diagonal classification is not established.

status_evidence.title: Adelic Dynamics and Arithmetic Quantum Unique Ergodicity (Lindenstrauss)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses adelic versions of measure rigidity and the role of p-adic factors, but frames a general adelic diagonal measure classification as a guiding open problem.
status_evidence.claim: The general classification of D(A')-invariant ergodic measures is treated as an open direction.
